title: Carl's Doomsday Scenario
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: The second book in a series about a deadly televised dungeon that has swallowed the planet. Carl and his cat push deeper into the levels, where the rules shift and the monsters and the game's producers get nastier.
readIf: you finished the first book and want more of the same wisecracking, high-body-count levelling.
skipIf: you have not read the first book, because the series builds directly and you will want to start there.

pairings.reason: The series opener sets up the game, the cat and the stakes this sequel assumes you know.
Also about one person problem-solving their way through hostile conditions with a sarcastic voice, minus the gore.
Another enclosed, rule-bound survival world, but quiet, bleak and driven by mystery rather than jokes.
